_readme: Hand-sourced character portraits, for cards the automatic pipeline cannot picture.
Keyed by show slug, then by the character name EXACTLY as the spine writes it
(the `name` field of a season's characters entry) -- not the credited cast name.
Only needed where TVMaze carries no in-character image AND no actor headshot may
stand in. That is almost entirely animation: a voice actor's face is not the
character, so upload-recap refuses the headshot fallback there and the card falls
back to key art with no face on it.
A URL here wins over everything, including a resolved cast row, so it is also the
escape hatch for a portrait that resolves to the wrong picture.
Run `node scripts/rank-faceless.mjs` for the current worklist, ordered by how
much each missing picture actually costs the recap.
